custodyProfile.uncertainty: These provider rows describe upstream collateral context, not identified immediate MegaUSD reserve custodians. The issuer API labels reserve wallets by address and the Mint User Agreement refers to unnamed institutional custodians with reserves separate from operating accounts. Public material does not independently prove who controls each custody wallet, enforceable segregation, insolvency treatment or reuse restrictions.
